subject: P3 BUG: grade-a-flash triggers at 93% but Grade 4 threshold is 92%
body:
BUG: Grade 4 triggers at 92% but celebration flash triggers at 93%

File: exam.html
Lines: 1037 (grade cutoff) and 1090, 1103 (flash trigger)
Severity: P3 — UX/morale issue (no data corruption)

CURRENT CODE
Line 1037: var grade = pct >= 92 ? 4 : pct >= 82 ? 3 : pct >= 70 ? 2 : 1;
Line 1090: if (pct >= 93) { el.classList.add('grade-a-flash'); ... }
Line 1103: if (pct >= 93) { el.classList.add('grade-a-flash'); ... }

WHAT HAPPENS
Kai gets 92% on a test. showScorecard() assigns grade = 4 (correct).
"Grade 4" badge renders. No celebration flash fires.
Kai earns the top grade and gets no visual reward. That is backwards.

FIX: Change both grade-a-flash triggers from >= 93 to >= 92

Line 1090: change: if (pct >= 93) to if (pct >= 92)
Line 1103: change: if (pct >= 93) to if (pct >= 92)

RATIONALE
SAAS grading: 92+ = A. When Kai hits the A threshold, he should get the flash.
The 93 number is likely a copy-paste error or off-by-one from an older 93=A scale.
92 is the correct boundary per the grade logic on line 1037.

GR note: No math content change. GA can implement without GR verification.
